title: Advanced Legal & Contracts
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado términos legales complejos. Entender los contratos y la jerga legal te protegerá y te dará ventaja en los negocios internacionales.

parts.visual:
Términos de Contratos: 
- Loophole (Vacío legal / Escapatoria). 
- Null and void (Nulo y sin valor). 
- Breach of contract (Incumplimiento de contrato). 
Ej: If you find a loophole, the agreement might become null and void, leading to a breach of contract.
parts.audio: Contract Terms. A loophole is an ambiguity or inadequacy in the law or a set of rules. Null and void means having no legal force. Breach of contract is failing to perform any term of a contract. For example: If you find a loophole, the agreement might become null and void, leading to a breach of contract.

parts.visual:
Responsabilidad y Propiedad: 
- Liable (Responsable legalmente / Sujeto a pagar daños). 
- Intellectual Property / IP (Propiedad intelectual). 
- Non-disclosure agreement / NDA (Acuerdo de confidencialidad). 
Ej: To protect our intellectual property, everyone must sign an NDA, otherwise they are liable for damages.
parts.audio: Liability and Property. Liable means legally responsible. Intellectual Property, or I P, refers to creations of the mind like inventions or designs. A non-disclosure agreement, or N D A, is a confidentiality contract. For example: To protect our intellectual property, everyone must sign an N D A, otherwise they are liable for damages.

questions.question: The lawyer found a ____ in the tax laws that saved the company millions. (Vacío legal / Escapatoria).
Because it wasn't signed by both parties, the contract is null and ____. (Sin valor / Nulo).
questions.explanation: Null and void = nulo y sin efecto legal.

questions.question: If you don't deliver the goods on time, it will be considered a ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: The company was found ____ for the damages caused by the defective product. (Responsable legalmente).
questions.explanation: Liable = responsable a nivel legal o financiero.

questions.question: Before I show you the prototype, you must sign an ____ (Non-Disclosure Agreement). (Acuerdo de confidencialidad).
We need to patent our algorithm to protect our Intellectual ____. (Propiedad intelectual).
The fine print in the contract contains many hidden ____. (Cláusulas).
They threatened to ____ us if we didn't pay the compensation. (Demandarnos).
A ____ action lawsuit was filed by thousands of affected customers. (Demanda colectiva).
This document is legally ____. You cannot back out now. (Vinculante / Obligatorio).
We need to ____ a contract before we start the project. (Redactar).
questions.explanation: Draft a contract = redactar un contrato.

questions.question: The two parties reached a ____ out of court. (Acuerdo / Arreglo).
We had to pay $50,000 in ____ to the injured worker. (Daños / Indemnización).
questions.explanation: Damages = indemnización por daños y perjuicios.

questions.question: A patent ____ gives you the exclusive right to use the invention. (Infracción - NO, la correcta es que la patente da el derecho. Si alguien la viola es infringement. La frase correcta sería: 'They committed copyright ____'). (Infracción).
questions.explanation: Infringement = infracción (de derechos de autor, patentes, etc).

questions.question: If they don't comply, we will take legal ____. (Acción / Medidas).
questions.explanation: Take legal action = tomar medidas legales.

questions.question: He was accused of corporate ____, stealing secrets for a rival. (Espionaje).
A ____ is a person who exposes illegal activity within a company. (Denunciante / Soplon).
questions.explanation: Whistleblower = informante o denunciante (quien 'toca el silbato').

questions.question: They filed a ____ claiming we copied their design. (Demanda).
The contract was signed under ____, so it is not valid. (Coacción / Presión).
questions.explanation: Under duress = bajo coacción o amenaza.

questions.question: To avoid a trial, they agreed to ____. (Arbitraje).
questions.explanation: Arbitration = arbitraje (resolución de conflictos por un tercero neutral sin ir a juicio).

questions.question: A legal ____. (Vacío legal con L)
Null and ____. (Sin valor con V)
____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
We are legally ____. (Responsables legales con L)
Non-Disclosure Agreement is ____. (Acrónimo)
Intellectual ____. (Propiedad con P)
To ____ someone. (Demandar con S)
Legally ____. (Vinculante con B)
To reach a ____. (Acuerdo extrajudicial con S)
Copyright ____. (Infracción con I)
